messages:
maya: Heads-up — SEO checklist for next Tue launch. Need keyword map, schema snippets, canonical rules, and redirect list. Quick volunteers?

 dave: I can take schema (product + FAQ) and canonical rules. Will keep FAQ answers short per Google guidelines.

 sara-m: I'll own keywords + internal linking. Prefer a Google Sheet but will export CSV for infra. I'll include intent (informational / transactional) and priority.

 leo: Redirects: we still have old slugs that must 301. Proposed mappings below — confirm final slugs and I'll open PR.

 maya: For webinar landing UTMs, propose utm_source=blog, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=q2_launch_webinar_v1. Landing page canonicalizes to itself; CTAs from blog include UTMs but canonical -> launch product page.

 analytics-bot: FYI: GA filter currently strips utm_medium=internal on our test config. Use distinct utm_medium values to avoid collision.

 dave: Draft FAQ JSON-LD (will refine after copy pass):
```json
{ "@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Redwood Inference?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Redwood Inference is a high-performance platform for serving LLMs across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."}}]}
```

 sara-m: Top anchor suggestions for internal linking (aim for top 8-12 per pillar): 'LLM inference latency', 'cost per token', 'dedicated GPU pools', 'private deployment options', 'model routing', 'prefix caching', 'quantization recommendations', 'observability', 'webinar registration', 'benchmarks', 'open models catalog'. I'll map anchors to target pages in the sheet.

 leo: Redirect rewrite snippet I'll include in PR (example):
```
/inference-old  -> /product/inference  301
/dedicated-old  -> /product/dedicated 301
/private-old    -> /product/private   301
/benchmarks/v1  -> /benchmarks        301
```

 maya: Great. Leo 1: can you tag @sara-m and @dave in the PR review? After merge let's run Screaming Frog and compare pre/post crawl.

 analytics-bot: Scheduled site crawl: Sat 03:00 UTC. Will report 404s, redirect chains, and orphaned pages.

 maya: Thanks all. We'll consolidate final assets into /marketing/seo-q2-launch doc and lock URLs by EOD Fri. :rocket:
